content: An empty barrel makes the loudest noise when rolled down the hill.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
sourceWork: Is minic a bhíonn an soitheach folamh glórach — Irish Proverb
explanation: A barrel filled to the brim with rich, aged wine rolls down the lane with heavy, dignified silence. But an empty wooden cask echoes with obnoxious clatter at every pebble. Loud boasting and endless talking are almost always the confession of an empty soul.
practicalInsight: Let your work be filled with heavy, quiet substance. Leave the loud rattling to the empty barrels.
reflectionPrompt: Do you feel the need to be the loudest voice in the room, or can you rest in the weight of quiet capability?
